strategy.overview: Fire Mountain builds E-R-U-P-T-I-O-N through the two side drop banks. Complete either bank to light the next letters; after the word is complete, hit the center drop target to collect Special. The left and right banks also build separate end-of-ball bonuses. Lit top rollovers advance both bonuses by two steps. Upper lane targets raise Bonus X. The right bank advances the ball-return gate, while the left bank advances the left-outlane Special.
strategy.simpleOverview: Complete either side drop bank to spell E-R-U-P-T-I-O-N. When the word is complete, hit the center drop target for Special. The two banks also build separate bonuses: the right bank advances ball return and the left bank advances the left-outlane Special. Use upper lane targets for Bonus X.
strategy.summary: Finish the nearer side bank rather than alternating loose hits. Build E-R-U-P-T-I-O-N, then prioritize the center drop target. Use the right bank for safety or the left bank for the outlane Special route.

quickInfo.name: Collect Special
quickInfo.summary: Finish E-R-U-P-T-I-O-N, then hit the center drop.

steps.text: Complete either the left or right drop-target bank to light the next E-R-U-P-T-I-O-N letters.
After E-R-U-P-T-I-O-N is complete, hit the center drop target to collect Special.
Use the right bank to advance the ball-return gate or the left bank to advance the left-outlane Special.
Hit upper lane targets to advance Bonus X; take lit top rollovers to move both end-of-ball bonuses two positions.

alternatives.title: Use the spinner setup
alternatives.when: Use this when a side bank is partly down and the spinner is available.

steps.text: Shoot the spinner to light bonus and FIRE target lamps briefly.
Use the lit sequence to finish the corresponding side progress without forcing a direct bank shot.
Complete full side banks to add letters efficiently.
Once the word is complete, switch immediately to the center drop target.

machineSetup: Check E-R-U-P-T-I-O-N difficulty, Bonus X, ball-return gate, left-outlane Special, spinner timer, and Special award.
Test both side banks, center drop, upper lane targets and top rollovers, spinner, ball-return gate, left outlane, and all sequence lamps.

cautions.response: Have the next side-target route ready before shooting the spinner.
